research_notes: Follow-up: resolve Slater and Gordon 1990 versus 1993 start using employer/admission/articles records and establish full-time hours, breaks and actual departure. Check pre-1993 jobs, paid student-office terms, ACTU campaign leave and ASCC end date.

2026-09-29: examined APH biography, first speech, ACTU contemporary material, Slater and Gordon history, NOHSC 2002–03 and 2005–06 annual reports, and ABC election profile. Historical annual report adds primary employer and governance evidence omitted from APH, but introduces an unresolved legal-work start conflict.

2026-09-29: searched employer-site Marles references, full-time terms, student history, additional directorships and ACTU departure. No adequately supported private-law full-time interval or exact exit found. Full-time references about military recruitment are unrelated to his own career and were rejected.

Do not turn legal degrees, union casework or ministerial responsibility into additional private legal or public-service years. Student and government committee roles are chronology entries only unless substantive employment is independently evidenced.

The record preserves both solicitor start claims in the spell note. No January dates invented for year-only sources; no numerical duration calculated from either conflicting span. Missing public employment evidence is not a confirmed zero.
